title: New in Symfony 8.2: Smarter Controller Arguments
content:
<html><head></head><body>Symfony can inject services, map request data into typed objects and
fetch Doctrine entities based on the arguments of your controllers. Symfony
8.2 improves this feature to make it work in more cases, and some
improvements apply to console commands too.…</body></html>
author: Javier Eguiluz
